The live project repository does contain a populated templates/ directory at its root (outside .gbg/), so the package genuinely has this surface; it simply was not carried into this round's snapshot. Per RULE.TEST.MISSING_IS_FAILING ('a zero count is a dead lane rather than a clean one') and RULE.INST.SELF_REPORT, this must be reported as a dead lane, not as a clean pass with zero findings. Concretely: the consolidated round report would otherwise read 'templates: 0 findings, surface clean' when zero files were ever read, and any genuine drift in a rendered template (a stray `{{slot}}` the renderer never fills, or a template that would render invalid YAML/JSON/sh) would silently pass every round that reuses this same broken checkout.
findings.resolution_hint: Fix the round's checkout/export step so it copies templates/ (and the other data directories under `catalog/`, `policy/`, `schema/` the tool ships, per CLAUDE.md's 'Data, never code' list) into the /tmp/jl_XGd0LR snapshot, then re-run the templates lane against the corrected ground truth before this round closes; do not bank this lane's result as a clean zero.
